items.html: Then these lights from its Tabur and below, that rose in the place of the Chazeh, were there as Mayin Nukvin to the Nukva, which are the tastes of SAG. Through these MAN was the aforementioned coupling, and through this coupling, they engendered a new light, and that new light descended and breached that Parsa, since above her, in the place of the Chazeh, there are now many lights, and the place does not have the strength to tolerate them. Thus, the Parsa was breached and the light descended through there from Tabur down, and filled that entire place that was empty of this newly born light. This is the meaning of the words of The Zohar [Beresheet]: “draws from above, and gives below.”
